title: PutRequest
description: Items of one source to store or replace, with the fetch bookkeeping of the page they came in.

source.description: The source of every item in items; local for items the owner writes.

kinds.description: The kinds this source produces, as its fetch response gave them; an item of another kind is refused, and a local item may not take a kind a source produces.

items.description: The items to store, each replacing a stored item with the same id.

cursor.description: The source's cursor after these items; saved once they are stored and given back by status, so the next sync continues there.

cost.description: What fetching these items cost; recorded once per page, before the items are stored, so a retried put never counts it twice.

selector.description: The selector these items were fetched with; status reports it, so a reader can tell when the configured selector has changed since.

item.description: One item in the envelope every source produces and the store keeps.

id.description: <source>:<external id>: unique in the store, the same on every sync, and what digests and answers cite.

kind.description: What the item is, such as post or email; data holds what only this kind has, and the store refuses a kind the item's source does not produce.

source.description: The source that produced the item, the same as the prefix of its id; local for items the owner wrote.

at.description: When the item was created at its source, an ISO 8601 time with a zone; since, until, lookback windows and prune compare it.

title.description: A subject or heading, or null when the kind has none, as a post has none.

text.description: The body as plain text; full-text search and the selector's text terms look here.

url.description: Where the owner can open the item, or null when there is no such page.

author.description: Who wrote the item as its source names them, a handle or an address, or null; the selector's authors match it.

items.description: One label, list, folder or channel name.

labels.description: The lists, labels, folders or channels the item is in; the selector's labels match them.

data.description: Fields only this kind has, such as the counts of likes on a post; stored as JSON and never matched by the selector.

selector.description: Which items a source fetches and the store keeps or returns. Every field given must match; within a list one value is enough. An empty selector matches every item.

items.description: An author's handle or address, or a pattern with *.

authors.description: Items whose author is one of these, ignoring case and a leading @; * matches any run of characters, so *@example.com matches every address at that domain.

items.description: A label, list, folder or channel name.

labels.description: Items that carry at least one of these labels, ignoring case: lists on X, labels and folders in Gmail.

items.description: A word or phrase to look for.

text.description: Items whose title or text contains at least one of these terms, ignoring case.

since.description: Items created at or after this time.

limit.description: The most items one sync fetches over all its pages, or one query returns.

native.description: Fields only the bound source understands, such as a Gmail search string; the source applies them and the store's matcher ignores them.

items.description: Items the provider billed for, which may be more than were returned.
